name: paris-cab-service
description: Private transfers in Paris: routes between the airports (CDG, Orly, Beauvais), Paris, Disneyland Paris and Versailles, their published prices, and how to book on the Paris Cab Service website.

interface.longDescription:
Paris Cab Service runs private transfers with a driver between Paris, the Charles de Gaulle (CDG), Orly (ORY) and Beauvais (BVA) airports, Disneyland Paris, Villages Nature, La Vallée Village and Versailles.

Ask ChatGPT for a route and it can:
- find the matching transfers and their published 'from' price, journey time and distance,
- show the details of one route: passengers and bags included, a short description and the answers to common questions (child seats, waiting time, luggage),
- give the booking page and the phone / WhatsApp number.

Routes are available in English, French, Italian and Spanish. This app only reads published information: it does not book, pay or ask for personal details. Bookings are made by the traveller on pariscabservice.eu.
capabilities: Search private transfer routes in Paris
Show route details, inclusions and FAQ
Give the booking page and contact details
defaultPrompt: How much is a private transfer from CDG airport to Disneyland Paris?
Find a ride from Orly airport to central Paris
How do I book a transfer from Beauvais airport to Paris?

positive.description: Finds a route and its published price from an airport code.
positive.prompt: How much is a private transfer from CDG airport to Disneyland Paris for 2 people?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_transfers with from 'CDG' and to 'Disneyland'. Answers with the single route 'CDG airport → Disneyland Paris', its 'from' price in EUR (one way, 2 passengers and 2 bags), journey time and the link to the route page. Does not list the reverse route Disneyland → CDG.

positive.description: Shows the details of one route, including the FAQ.
positive.prompt: I land at Orly with my family. Is a child seat included on the ride from Orly to Disneyland, and how much luggage can we bring?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_transfers to find the Orly → Disneyland route, then get_transfer with its slug. Answers from the returned FAQ and inclusions (passengers and bags included, child seats) and gives the route page link.

positive.description: Explains how to book and hands over the booking link.
positive.prompt: Can you book me a ride from Beauvais airport to Paris next Friday at 9am?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_booking_info. Explains that the booking is made on the website, gives the booking page link and the phone / WhatsApp number, and lists the details to prepare (addresses, date and time, flight number, passengers, bags, child seats). Does not claim to have booked anything.

positive.description: Answers in French with French pages.
positive.prompt: Combien coûte un transfert privé de l'aéroport de Beauvais à Paris ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_transfers with locale 'fr' and from 'Beauvais'. Answers in French with the Beauvais routes, their 'from' prices in EUR and links under https://www.pariscabservice.eu/fr/.

positive.description: Keeps the direction of travel for a return trip.
positive.prompt: What is the price from Disneyland Paris back to Charles de Gaulle airport?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_transfers with from 'Disneyland' and to 'CDG' (or 'Charles de Gaulle'). Answers with the route 'Disneyland Paris → CDG airport' only, its 'from' price and its link.

negative.description: A ride outside the Paris region is not covered.
negative.prompt: Get me a taxi from JFK airport to Manhattan in New York.

negative.description: General travel questions unrelated to transfers.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing about Paris needs no transfer data.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the Eiffel Tower at night.

review.commerce_description: No purchase happens in ChatGPT. The tools only return published routes, prices and contact details, and link to the company's own website, where the traveller books and pays.

publication.release_notes: First release: three read-only tools (search_transfers, get_transfer, get_booking_info) over the published Paris transfer routes, in English, French, Italian and Spanish.

fr-FR.subtitle: Transferts aéroports & Disney
fr-FR.description:
Paris Cab Service propose des transferts privés avec chauffeur entre Paris, les aéroports Charles de Gaulle (CDG), Orly et Beauvais, Disneyland Paris, Villages Nature, La Vallée Village et Versailles.

Demandez un trajet à ChatGPT : il trouve les transferts correspondants avec leur prix « à partir de » publié, la durée et la distance, affiche le détail d'un trajet (passagers et bagages inclus, questions fréquentes) et donne la page de réservation et le numéro de téléphone / WhatsApp.

Cette app lit uniquement des informations publiées : elle ne réserve pas, ne prend pas de paiement et ne demande aucune donnée personnelle. La réservation se fait sur pariscabservice.eu.
